description: Accounts in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals. The ghulām of the Rayyis Saʿd is mentioned at least twice. Mentions "pens and ink" (aqlām wa-midād). Another payment is for ḥashīsha. Mentions a customs payment of 3 dinars and 2 qirats at the Ṣināʿa. The other side mentions Abū ʿImrān and the Ṣināʿa again. Mentions Abū Ṭawq several times and Ibn al-Munshid.
description_he: חשבונות בכתב ערבי ובספרות יווניות/קופטיות; הע'לאם של הראיס מוזכר לפחות פעמיים
